capabilities: Create sidekick statblocks from D&D 5e notes in Fantasy Statblocks format
Select sidekick class, level, and features through interactive prompts
Save generated statblock notes in the same or a default directory
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not edit or manage statblocks in general; it only generates sidekick statblocks using the rules from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.
extras: The README asks users to only use the plugin if they own Tasha's Cauldron of Everything and the statblocks' source materials. Known limits: language requirements for Expert and Spellcaster are not implemented, spells must be entered manually, and sidekick level is stored in the cr field even though level and CR are not equivalent. Future plans include sidekick levelling, Flee Mortals! rules, equipment management, and reduced-threat monsters.
intentEvidence: Its goal is to help you edit your Fantasy Statblocks and implement rules from various sources.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate or expand D&D 5e statblocks, and applying official sidekick rules by hand is tedious and error-prone.

relations.evidence: a valid D&D 5e statblock formatted using the statblock code block in the Fantasy Statblocks format

summary: Creates D&D 5e sidekick statblocks from existing Fantasy Statblocks notes, implementing the sidekick rules from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.
